title: DIMCIM: A Quantitative Evaluation Framework for Default-mode Diversity and Generalization in Text-to-Image Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image models using the DIMCIM framework, which calculates a 'Does-It Metric' (DIM) via VLM-based image-attribute scoring (VQAScore) to measure the default distribution and potential over/under-representation of visual object attributes (e.g., color, material, state, purpose) generated from under-specified coarse prompts.
